purpose: Track risks before a tenant creates an external candidate. This is an internal planning register, not an execution authorization.

risks.trigger: A draft uses a claim without current ProductTruth evidence.
risks.mitigation: Block the claim, attach reviewable evidence, or rewrite the draft as a clearly labeled future hypothesis.

risks.trigger: A brand, asset, source, destination, approval, receipt, prompt, or data record appears to come from another tenant.
risks.mitigation: Stop the workflow, remove the material, run the negative isolation test, and record only aggregate lessons after privacy review.

risks.trigger: A draft, research artifact, metric, or export contains an identifier, private content, sensitive profile, or sensitive inference.
risks.mitigation: Block the artifact, remove the data, review the intake path, and retain only approved aggregate synthesis.

risks.trigger: A visual, source, testimonial, product screenshot, or endorsement lacks rights or provenance proof.
risks.mitigation: Use only tenant-owned or licensed references with accessible descriptions and clear provenance.

risks.trigger: A proposed call to action leads to an unreviewed destination or collection flow.
risks.mitigation: Keep the destination disabled until functionality, consent, retention, and opt-out behavior are reviewed.

risks.trigger: A result, benchmark, or optimization decision is claimed without an approved denominator, event definition, or baseline.
risks.mitigation: Use definition-only events until aggregate telemetry and metric ownership are verified.

risks.trigger: A role attempts publishing, outreach, account connection, spend, lead collection, or scheduling without a later execution envelope.
risks.mitigation: Stop immediately; preserve only a sanitized internal record and require human review before any later retry.
